Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “born later” by comparing the directors’ ages at their films’ release years (39 vs 34) and concluded the older age meant a later birth. The correct comparison is by birth year: Gus Van Sant (1952) vs Massimo Ceccherini (1965). Since 1965 > 1952, Lucignolo’s director was born later, so the Planner’s final conclusion was reversed.
